name: Doorway Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway. Raise your arms out to the sides with your elbows bent about 90 degrees and at shoulder height.
Put your forearms and palms flat on the sides of the door frame.
Step forward slowly with one foot until you feel a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. Keep your shoulders down and back.
Hold for the set time and breathe normally. To change the area of the stretch, move your elbows a little higher or lower.
